# Data Sources and Input Datasets {#sec-data}

This appendix documents the origin, version, and role of every dataset used to build the resistance surface and to develop the QGIS plugin. All spatial layers were standardised to the Swiss coordinate reference system LV95 (EPSG:2056) before processing.

## Overview of Input Datasets

| Dataset | Provider | Version / edition | Native CRS | Role in the pipeline |
|---------------|---------------|---------------|---------------|---------------|
| Wild boar GPS telemetry | WILMA, ZHAW | 2014 to 2017, 16 individuals | LV03 (EPSG:21781) | Empirical calibration of the iSSF |
| swissBOUNDARIES3D | swisstopo | 1.5 | LV95 (LN02) | Cantonal study area extents |
| swissTLM3D | swisstopo | 2026 edition | LV95 | Forest, roads, railways, settlements, water |
| DHM25 (`dhm25_grid_raster.asc`) | swisstopo | legacy, surveyed 1952 to 1999 | LV03 (EPSG:21781) | Slope and Terrain Ruggedness Index |
| Wildlife passages (`Wildtierpassagen.gdb`) | FOEN | N2023 version | LV95 | Permeability override at crossing structures |
| Permanent ASP fences (`Dauerzaeune.shp`) | WILMA, ZHAW | December 2024 | LV95 | Absolute barriers in the Zürich surface |
| Wild boar core habitats (`Potenzial_Wildschwein_Kerneinstaende_ZH_2024_WILMA.shp`) | WILMA, ZHAW | December 2024 | LV95 | Spatial validation anchors and LCP targets |

: Overview of input datasets, their providers, versions, native coordinate systems, and roles in the modelling pipeline. {#tbl-datasets}

## Data Availability

All base geodata are drawn from publicly accessible Swiss federal services (swisstopo, FOEN). The GPS telemetry and the permanent ASP fence shapefile were provided by the project partners (WILMA, ZHAW) and are not publicly redistributable. The processing scripts that transform these inputs into the final resistance rasters are documented in @sec-reproducibility.
